core_mechanic: read before a short two-choice answer
choose one target word for endless reaction rounds
currentManifest.duration_note: numeric design hypotheses; human first failure, reading time and0.5-second skill are unmeasured; reading and transition choices have no deadline
currentManifest.primary_score: questions1–20:100 each /21–50:200 each /51+:500 each; no hidden reaction bonus
currentManifest.secondary_score: final streak with an independent local best
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: Cumulative questions1–20 get2s,21–50 get1.5s,51+ get0.5s. Ten images, ten untimed reads with READY release, then chosen-word endless final mode.
currentManifest.risk_reward: One mistake or timeout ends immediately. Every answer layout is independently random; no colored-choice hints or forced left-right alternation.
currentManifest.visual_identity: twenty actual pop clean generated icons, warm cream two-choice stage, equal-looking native answer buttons
currentManifest.tutorial: one generated image without a deadline, one correct native choice before the real run
